newsitem.title: CHINA: China pager market seen expanding rapidly.
newsitem.headline: China pager market seen expanding rapidly.

text.p: The number of pager subscribers in China was expected to expand by six to nine million a year through to the year 2000, the Economic Information Daily said on Tuesday.
More than 25 million people already use pager services, making China the second biggest market in the world after the United States, the newspaper said.
About 2,100 cities in China provided pager services as of the end of 1995, it said.
The retail cost of a numerical display pager is $80 and the price for a pager than can display Chinese characters is $140, it said.
China produces some pagers, but many are imported or are assembled domestically by foreign companies.
Motorola Inc and NEC Corp are among the most successful foreign brands in the China market.
